_comment: Primitives that do NOT support a capability, with the reason. Consumed by
scripts/audit-primitive-capabilities.js. An entry whose component now PASSES is itself a gate
failure, so this list can only shrink — it cannot rot into a permanent excuse.
capability: C1 = R1 children slot, C2 = R2 context publish, C3 = R2 context consume, C4 = R3 data access.

exceptions.reason: Root orchestrator, not a leaf primitive: it composes the dialog's child primitives directly and renders through #host + showDefault() + shadow DOM across three render modes. Children on the three dialog hosts is a known open design decision (docs/primitives-children.md 'What this release does NOT cover'); every primitive it composes supports children individually.
